objects.constraint public.payment_checkout_attem: FOREIGN KEY (current_booking_id) REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
objects.constraint public.payment_refund_obligat: FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id) REFERENCES payment_checkout_attempts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((((attempts = 0) AND (first_attempted_at IS NULL)) OR ((attempts > 0) AND (first_attempted_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK ((((lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL)) OR ((lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (state = 'requested'::text))))

objects.index public.bookings.bookings_payment_r: CREATE INDEX bookings_payment_reconciliation_scan ON public.bookings USING btree (id) WHERE (payment_hold_expires_at IS NOT NULL)

objects.index public.payment_stripe_events.payme: CREATE INDEX payment_stripe_events_findings ON public.payment_stripe_events USING btree (account_id, mode, event_id) WHERE (finding IS NOT NULL)
